message.message:
This command will save information that must be restored after org refresh, in the following order:
- Certificates
- Other metadata
- Custom Settings
- Records
- Connected Apps 
- External Client Apps

IMPORTANT: the files saved under scripts/sandbox-refresh/ contain secrets in clear text (Consumer Secrets, credentials, custom settings data). NEVER commit or push them: keep them out of your repository and delete them once the refresh process is fully complete.
Creating sfdx-project for sandbox info storage
Save Project created in folder C:/helios/salesforce/scripts/sandbox-refresh/helios-solar--uatsandbox
